kjv: harden, impudent, prevail, strengthen (self), be strong.

occurrences.text: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the Lord delivered Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushan–rishathaim.
And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.
Arise, O Lord; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.
That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
